name: star graph — bipartite
code:
edges = [(0, i) for i in range(1, 6)]
assert is_bipartite(6, edges) == True

name: odd cycle of length 5 — not bipartite
code:
edges = [(i, (i + 1) % 5) for i in range(5)]
assert is_bipartite(5, edges) == False

name: disconnected: one component bipartite, one not
K₄ — not bipartite (contains triangles)
code:
edges = [(i, j) for i in range(4) for j in range(i + 1, 4)]
assert is_bipartite(4, edges) == False

name: K₂,₃ (complete bipartite) — bipartite
code:
edges = [(i, j + 2) for i in range(2) for j in range(3)]
assert is_bipartite(5, edges) == True

name: large even cycle — bipartite
code:
edges = [(i, (i + 1) % 100) for i in range(100)]
assert is_bipartite(100, edges) == True

name: double edge between same nodes — still valid
stress test: large random graph with known bipartition
